user.title: Set up Tankpriser
user.description: Prices come from Danish fuel chains' official price APIs (OK, Q8, F24, Shell, OIL!). Your area is your Home location — just choose which fuel types to track. The radius (default 10 km) can be changed later under Options.

error.no_fuel_types: Select at least one fuel type.

settings.title: Area & fuel types
settings.description: Adjust the radius around your Home location, choose fuel types and hide stations you do not care about.

notifications.title: Price notifications
notifications.description: Get notified when prices change in your area.

chains.title: Chains & API keys
chains.description: Most Danish chains publish their prices openly and need no setup — OK, Q8, F24, Shell and OIL! work out of the box. The chains below only answer with a personal API key that you must request yourself. Pick one to see how.

provider.title: {name} API key

data_description.api_key: The key is checked immediately — if the chain rejects it you will see an error here.

error.invalid_auth: The chain rejected that key. Check that you copied all of it and that it has been activated.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the chain's API. Check your internet connection and try again.
error.no_stations: The key was accepted but no stations came back. The account may not have access yet, or the chain changed its format — please open an issue.

abort.no_credential_chains: No chain currently needs an API key — every supported chain publishes its prices openly.

options.any_change: Any price change in the area
options.below_threshold: When the cheapest price drops below the threshold
options.decrease_only: Only when the cheapest price decreases
